financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Follow-on public offering closed Oct 31, 2024 (7,142,858 shares at $42.00) plus underwriters' option exercise on Nov 5, 2024 (1,071,428 shares); aggregate net proceeds
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The Company received aggregate net proceeds of approximately $323.6 million, after deducting underwriting discounts and commissions of $20.7 million, and offering costs of approximately $0.7 million.
